title: Inkwell Chargeboard: Per-token chargeboard UX spec, attribution flows & export patterns
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Design an auditable, role-aware per-token chargeboard that surfaces cost drivers at message- and token-granularity, shows attribution across prompts/users/routes, supports export to CSV/Parquet, and provides UI pricing-patterns for slabed and tiered billing. Background: customers want to reconcile token spend to product features and user journeys; existing Console views show aggregate token spend but lack traceable rows and export schemas that finance/engineering can consume. This ticket delivers: 1) a high-fidelity UI spec for a chargeboard table + timeline panes, 2) export schema (CSV/Parquet) and example payloads, 3) interaction patterns for filtering, sampling, and rollup, 4) visual guidance for pricing slabs, rounding, and role-restricted columns, 5) prototype screens for usability testing. Constraints: large-org scale (millions of rows), must not expose tokens for PII-sensitive routes, must respect RBAC and retention policies. Trade-offs considered: - Full message-level expansion vs sampled detail: default to sampled detail with deterministic anchors for drilldown (keeps table responsive). - Showing raw token counts vs normalized cost-per-message: provide both, with normalized metric selectable. Deliverables: annotated Figma screens, Confluence export spec, JSON/CSV example exports, accessibility notes, and QA checklist for ENG implementation.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma with table, timeline, and detail flyout with annotations and developer notes
Export spec documented in Confluence with CSV and Parquet column list and example rows
Role-aware column visibility defined (Admin/Finance/Developer) and verified in prototype
Performance patterns documented (sampling algorithm, pagination, server-side aggregation) with suggested defaults
Design review comments addressed and sign-off from PM and Eng leads
